research_result.description: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support platform that provides ticketing, contacts, kb solutions, and helpdesk automation capabilities with extensive REST API coverage and MCP server integration.
research_result.credential_requirements: API keys can be obtained from the Profile Settings page of a Freshdesk account. API access is supported on trial accounts and paid plans (Growth, Pro, Enterprise), but is not available on the free Sprout plan.

evidence.claim: Freshdesk provides REST APIs (v2) allowing RESTful operations across tickets, contacts, companies, and helpdesk resources.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Freshdesk's APIs belong to the Representational State Transfer (REST) category. They allow you to perform 'RESTful' operations such as reading, modifying, adding or deleting data from your helpdesk.

evidence.claim: Freshdesk does not offer a native public GraphQL API endpoint.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Freshdesk does not offer a native public GraphQL endpoint — all official API access is provided through the versioned REST API.

evidence.claim: Freshdesk supports API key authentication for API requests.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You can use your personal API key to authenticate the request. If you use the API key, there is no need for a password.

evidence.claim: Freshdesk supports Basic Access Authorization using helpdesk username and password.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Freshdesk uses Basic Access Authorization. This means, for authentication, you can use the same username and password you use when logging into your helpdesk.

evidence.claim: Freshdesk provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration to interact with AI tools.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Freshworks Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI tools like Cursor and Claude to securely connect and interact with Freshdesk.

evidence.claim: API key and API functionality are not available on the free Sprout plan.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Note: If your account is on the Sprout plan, the API key and the API functionality will NOT be available.
